Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.schedule

Class DayNightCurve

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.schedule.DayNightCurve
public final class DayNightCurve extends Object
Pure, Java 3D-free math for the daylight/nightlight schedule: the day-night blend factor for a given clock time, the per-channel colour interpolation, and the day/night light and tint palettes.

Everything here is deterministic (the clock is injected) and free of any jogamp type, so the whole curve is unit-testable in the headless test JVM. The 3D light rig (StandardGlobalLights) and the 2D night veil (NightTintOverlay) consume these values but hold no logic of their own.

The blend factor is 0.0 in full daylight and 1.0 in full night, ramping linearly across a configurable window centred on each of the two transitions (dawn at the daylight time, dusk at the nightlight time). A window of zero minutes is a hard step.

  • Method Details

    • dayFactor

      public static float dayFactor(LocalTime now, LocalTime day, LocalTime night, int rampMinutes)
      Returns the day-night blend factor at now: 0.0 in full daylight, 1.0 in full night, ramping linearly across a rampMinutes-wide window centred on each transition. Handles a daylight window that crosses midnight; a non-positive ramp is a hard step.
      Parameters:
      now - the current clock time
      day - the daylight (dawn) transition time
      night - the nightlight (dusk) transition time
      rampMinutes - total width, in minutes, of each transition window

    • lerp

      public static float[] lerp(float[] day, float[] night, float t)
      Interpolates each channel from day to night by t (clamped to 0..1) and returns a new array; neither input is mutated.
